title: Sensor Tower: India was the largest market for GenAI app downloads in 2025, surging 207% YoY; India accounts for 20% of global installs but 1% of in-app revenue (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Sensor Tower: India was the largest market for GenAI app downloads in 2025, surging 207% YoY; India accounts for 20% of global installs but 1% of in-app revenue — Tech giants' efforts to ramp up AI adoption in India may be about to hit a turning point, as companies end free promotions …
